The '''KS-23''', unofficially known as the '''Hammer''', was a model of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The weapons fired explosive pellets over a short range and were primarily used by [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]].

==Description==
A model of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]], the ruggedly constructed KS-23 fired high-power, small-sized, explosive pellets which scattered from the barrel when fired to cover a wide area and do the most damage possible over short and medium ranges. The guns were about the size of a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]], with a sturdy action, and composite furniture. They used tubular, five-round magazines that ran underneath the large-caliber smoothbore barrel and had a self-loading firing mechanism which used the weapons powerful recoil for power. The weapons proved to be incredibly loud and unsubtle but were made from high quality, resilient, materials were relatively easy to repair.<ref name="ETU" />

==History==
The KS-23 made by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] and was popular but rare during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The weapons cost 1500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was initially produced for use by [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]] in taking down large creatures like [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] and [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]] but gained a wide following in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], with [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] often using them as well.<ref name="ETU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The KS-23 Hammer was first mentioned in ''[[Enter the Unknown]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Sterling Hershey]] and released in [[2013]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]] roleplaying game.

It shares the model name with the Soviet [[Wikipedia: KS-23|KS-23]], a large-bore riot shotgun.
